title: 911 for the Wrong Shade of Blue
summary: Karen reports existential zoning. Operator asks if anyone is bleeding. “Democracy is bleeding, Steven.” Transfer loop until pizza arrives.
visualArc: Kitchen clipboard + purple blinds | 911 fluorescents | pizza doorbell.
